component_guidelines.navbar: Sticky header with glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/80 z-50`. Includes Brand Logo, Home, Browse Items, Community Feed, My Reports, Watchlist, Notifications dropdown badge, Profile dropdown, and CTA button. Desktop nav items must be clearly visible.
component_guidelines.hero: Prominent H1 'Lost something? Let's bring it back to you.', dual primary CTAs: 'I LOST IT' (Solid Indigo with Alert Circle icon) and 'I FOUND IT' (Emerald / Teal gradient or solid button with Search/Plus icon), integrated quick search bar with location and category dropdown filters, background image with maximum 40% overlay.
component_guidelines.forms: Step-by-step report forms for Lost and Found items. Image upload preview with ML category prediction badge (e.g. 'Predicted: Tech / Headphones (89% confidence) - Click to edit'), private clues fields (for verification), duplicate warning modal when high similarity detected.
component_guidelines.claim_and_handover: Claim verification workflow modal/page asking private questions. Match score banner (0-100% score dial with explanation bullets). QR code generator for two-party confirmation during physical handover with digital receipt generated upon mutual scan.
component_guidelines.admin_dashboard: Clean multi-tab interface: Moderation Reports, Claims Review, Suspended Users, Audit Log, Campus Hotspots/Locations, and System Statistics with Recharts visuals.
component_guidelines.footer: Simple, clean academic footer with navigation sections: Help, Responsible Use Policy, Safety Guidelines, Privacy Policy, About, and copyright statement.

general_ui_ux_rules: NO EMOJIS as UI icons - strictly use lucide-react vector icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='submit-lost-report-button').
Header must NEVER be pure transparent over content - use glassmorphism with blur and background opacity.
Mandatory Responsible Use Policy checkbox in Registration/Login flows and item report forms.
Hover states must explicitly set text and background colors for optimal contrast.
Sonner library used for toasts (located in components/ui/sonner.jsx or via sonner package).
